names.note: Name page 13752 of days.pravoslavie.ru gives the surname the day line omits. The grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, as BRIEF-RUSSIAN §3 asks. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1918)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 20 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Константина пресвитера (1918).»

attestations.note: The day's fourth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page behind it. «иерей» on the name page and «пресвитера» on the line are the `presbyter` and the office `Priest`, a string the four locale packs carry. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
